Rescue Efforts Underway After Heavy Rain-Induced Landslides in India

Heavy rainfall has caused landslides and flooding across several states in India, resulting in loss of life and displacement. The government has deployed rescue teams to affected areas, while critics have raised concerns about the preparedness and response of local authorities.
